title.ko: discours indirect · concordance des temps · verbes introducteurs · hier → la veille
title.en: Reported speech: discours indirect · concordance des temps · reporting verbs · hier → la veille

explain.ko: 간접화법에서는 주절 동사가 과거이면 시제가 한 단계 이동합니다(concordance des temps): présent → imparfait, passé composé → plus-que-parfait, futur → conditionnel. 시간·장소 표현도 바뀝니다: hier → la veille, demain → le lendemain, ici → là, aujourd'hui → ce jour-là. 직접 의문문은 si, ce que 등으로 바뀝니다. 다양한 전달 동사를 쓰면 표현이 풍부해집니다: insister, suggérer, admettre, nier, avertir, promettre, expliquer, se plaindre. 뒤 구조는 동사에 따라 다릅니다: avertir qqn de + 부정사, admettre + 부정사 / que + 절.
explain.en: In reported speech, after a past reporting verb the tenses shift back (concordance des temps): présent → imparfait, passé composé → plus-que-parfait, futur → conditionnel. Time and place words change: hier → la veille, demain → le lendemain, ici → là, aujourd'hui → ce jour-là. Direct questions become si / ce que clauses. Varied reporting verbs enrich your language: insister, suggérer, admettre, nier, avertir, promettre, expliquer, se plaindre. The structure after each depends on the verb: avertir qqn de + infinitive, admettre + infinitive / que + clause.

head: 직접 / Direct
간접 / Indirect
예문 / Exemple
rows: « Je suis fatigué. » → Il a dit qu'il était fatigué.
« Je suis venu hier. » → Il a dit qu'il était venu la veille.
« Je viendrai demain. » → Il a promis qu'il viendrait le lendemain.
« Tu viens ? » → Il a demandé si je venais.

notes.ko: 전달 동사가 현재이면 시제가 바뀌지 않습니다: Il dit qu'il est fatigué.
notes.en: If the reporting verb is present, tenses do not shift.

notes.ko: avertir qqn de + 부정사, suggérer de + 부정사 / que + 접속법.
notes.en: Avertir qqn de + infinitive; suggérer de + infinitive / que + subjunctive.

notes.ko: 대명사와 소유형용사도 화자 관점에 맞게 바꿉니다.
notes.en: Pronouns and possessives shift to the reporter's point of view.

trans.ko:
A: 어제 부장님이 뭐라고 하셨어?
B: 보고서가 늦어서 걱정이라고 하셨어. 일찍 제출하라고 요청하셨고.
A: 그래서 뭐라고 대답했어?
B: 내일까지 끝내겠다고 약속했어.
trans.en:
A: What did the manager say yesterday?
B: She said she was worried because the report was late. She asked us to submit it early.
A: What did you answer?
B: I promised to finish it by the next day.

lines.t: Le médecin a averti le patient de réduire sa consommation d'alcool. Elle lui a aussi suggéré de marcher chaque jour. Le patient a promis de le faire. Il a admis qu'il avait négligé sa santé l'année précédente.

trans.ko: 의사는 환자에게 술을 줄이라고 경고했어요. 또한 매일 걷기를 제안했어요. 환자는 그렇게 하겠다고 약속했어요. 그는 지난해 건강을 소홀히 했던 것을 인정했어요.
trans.en: The doctor warned the patient to cut down on alcohol. She also suggested walking every day. The patient promised to do so. He admitted that he had neglected his health the year before.

options: De faire ce que le médecin disait

items.passage:
ACTUALITÉS
Lors de la conférence de presse d'hier, le maire a promis de ne pas augmenter les impôts l'année suivante. En réponse aux critiques sur l'insuffisance du budget, il a insisté sur le fait qu'il serait utilisé efficacement. Les membres de l'opposition ont demandé un plan détaillé.

trans.ko:
뉴스
시장은 어제 기자 회견에서 내년에 세금을 올리지 않겠다고 약속했다. 그는 예산이 부족하다는 비판에 대해 효율적으로 쓰겠다고 주장했다. 반대 의원들은 구체적인 계획을 요구했다.
trans.en:
NEWS
At yesterday's press conference the mayor promised not to raise taxes the following year. In response to criticism that the budget was short, he insisted that it would be used efficiently. Opposition members asked for a detailed plan.

items.passage: Jihu a proposé un nouveau projet pendant la réunion. Certains collègues ont dit qu'ils s'inquiétaient du coût. Finalement, ils ont accepté de l'essayer pendant un mois.

trans.ko: 지후는 회의에서 새 프로젝트를 제안했어요. 몇몇 동료는 비용을 걱정한다고 말했어요. 결국 그들은 한 달 동안 시험해 보기로 합의했어요.
trans.en: Jihu proposed a new project at the meeting. Some colleagues said they were worried about the cost. In the end they agreed to try it for a month.

prompt.ko: 친구에게 들은 이야기를 간접화법과 다양한 전달 동사를 써서 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write 4 sentences retelling what a friend said, using reported speech and varied reporting verbs.

task.model: Le médecin a dit au patient qu'il était fatigué à cause de l'alcool. Elle l'a averti de réduire sa consommation. Le patient a admis qu'il avait négligé sa santé. Il a promis de marcher chaque jour.

model_trans.ko: 친구는 지난주에 새 직장에서 힘들었다고 말했어요. 그는 상사가 너무 많은 일을 시킨다고 불평했어요. 저는 그에게 상사와 이야기해 보라고 조언했어요. 그는 다음 주에 그렇게 하겠다고 약속했어요.
model_trans.en: My friend said last week that he had had a hard time at his new job. He complained that his boss gave him too much work. I advised him to talk to his boss. He promised to do so the following week.
